settings.title: Heat, Humidity & Sunlight
settings.text: Padel rackets contain foam, carbon or fiberglass that can degrade under extreme heat, humidity, and prolonged sunlight.

settings.title: Rough Surfaces
settings.text: Direct contact with rough surfaces causes scratches, scuffs, and unnecessary wear.

settings.title: Impacts & Unprotected Transport
settings.text: Drops, knocks, and loose transport can chip the frame, cause scratches, and weaken your racket over time.

settings.heading: Wonder why your racket doesn’t last long?
settings.subheading: It’s not the racket, it’s the cover.

settings.title: Shade From Direct Sun
settings.text: Keeps sunlight off your racket between games.

settings.title: Covered On The Move
settings.text: A cotton and leather layer between your racket and the rest of your kit.

settings.title: No More Rough-Surface Contact
settings.text: Keeps your racket covered and protected from scratches.

settings.title: Safer Transport
settings.text: Carry your racket without leaving it exposed to other equipment.

settings.heading: Your Racket,
settings.body: A cotton and leather layer between your racket and everything else: the sun, the floor, the car boot and the rest of your kit.

settings.heading: Cotton, Leather and Metal.
settings.intro: A cotton body, leather trim and metal hardware. Made by hand in Bali.

settings.title: Built with protection in mind.
settings.text: Cotton and leather keep direct sun and scuffs off your racket.
settings.other_text: Many basic covers are one thin layer of nylon or synthetic fabric.

settings.title: Made for everyday carrying.
settings.text: Cotton, leather trim and metal hardware keep your racket covered in your bag and on the move.
settings.other_text: Thin, lightweight covers do little against bumps or being pressed against other equipment.

settings.title: Premium materials that last.
settings.text: A durable combination of cotton, leather and metal hardware, designed for long-term use.
settings.other_text: Often made from polyester, nylon or thin fabrics that wear out quickly and lose their shape.

settings.title: Designed for real players.
settings.text: A functional zip pocket, adjustable strap and carry handle make it easy to take everywhere.
settings.other_text: Many covers have no pocket, comfortable strap or carry handle.
